text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sunny weather suddenly clouds
over, and rain
starts pouring down soon
after.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, what gives?! Why's it gotta be
when I'm
running?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just my luck. Guess that's all for me
today, then.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm fine. These won't take too
long to dry
if I just leave them alone.
choice_data_list: Why don't you hurry and get changed?
Why don't you get changed quickly?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Th-that was just a coincidence! I'm not
gonna get
a cold just from this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So she says, but a few days later, Vodka
isn't
looking so good.
